title: Grit chamber.
officialText:
All drywells shall contain a grit chamber as part of the drywell system. Grit chambers shall be
constructed in accordance with the following requirements:
1. Solid access cover with a minimum diameter of 15 inches (381 mm).
2. Grit chamber designed to support the maximum anticipated load.
3. Outlet invert elevation shall be a minimum of 1 inch (25 mm) lower than the lowest inlet elevation.
4. The sump shall be a minimum of 18 inches (450 mm) or two times the largest inlet pipe diameter, whichever is greater,
as measured to the outlet invert elevation.
5. The interior dimensions shall be a minimum of 18 inches (450 mm) or four times the largest inlet pipe diameter
whichever is greater.
